business_problem: Loblaw's Marketing & Brands teams wanted to move faster, improve consistency, reduce manual effort in repeatable work, and create more time for higher-value thinking that improves customer experience.
solution_summary: Loblaw's Marketing & Brands organization used ChatGPT Enterprise as the core implementation platform for Project Trailblaze, a structured internal AI program focused on real operating work rather than abstract experimentation. More than 120 participants across 24 teams completed training, reviewed case studies in advance, and then used ChatGPT Enterprise during a two-day build event to create 24 GPT prototypes aligned to specific workflows such as copy creation, content review, meeting-note generation, vendor information checks, sales updates, competitive scanning, and briefing support. The source describes the user input layer as practical business challenges and pre-read case materials entering the GPT environment, with ChatGPT Enterprise performing the generative processing and serving outputs directly to marketing users. Loblaw does not name a separate storage tier, orchestration stack, or external system integrations. After judging, the prototypes entered a governed refinement phase in which they are being measured, prioritized, and prepared for broader adoption.
